actual: MA-E05 durable runs targeting online node wsl2-5080 fail before remote submission. Both orthogonality_aware children end in dispatch_failed/remote_path_invalid because remote_dispatch.py rejects the WSL node API artifact_store_root /mnt/f/Dev/RD-Agent-state/artifact_cas. The registered local WSL node also uses loopback api_base_url and /mnt/f workspace paths, while remote Linux nodes must continue rejecting Windows-mounted paths. Fix must distinguish a loopback local-WSL compute node from a genuinely remote Linux node, preserve fail-closed path validation for remote nodes, add targeted regression tests, and require fresh-process runtime verification after merge. Do not control backend processes.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
